Vote/ranking counters (handlelike, db.js:140, route POST /api/recipes/:recipe_id/like) — multi-step read-then-write across likes/ranking tables with no transaction; recipe_id taken raw from req.params (never parseInt/NaN-checked unlike sibling routes) before being used in SQL and ranking updates.

Comments ownership (dbAddComment/dbDeleteComment, db.js:343-387, routes POST /api/recipes/:id/comments, DELETE /api/comments/:comment_id) — delete permission logic allows either the comment author or the recipe owner, computed via a join; body length/content only checked in the route, not at storage.

Recipe creation & deletion (insertRecipe/dbDeleteRecipe, db.js:243-282, routes POST /api/recipes, DELETE /api/recipes/:id) — recipe_id derived from parseInt(uuid(),16) (server-picked but worth checking for collisions/predictability), two-statement insert (recipes then ranking) with no transaction, ownership check-then-delete plus best-effort photo unlink using the stored path.

Upload storage & retrieval (file_uploud.js, route POST /api/recipes via multer; GET /data/recipes_pics/:filename in routes/recipe.js) — file extension taken from the client-supplied original filename (only mimetype is filtered, not extension), stored filename keyed on server recipeId so a second upload silently overwrites; retrieval trusts path.basename() as its only traversal guard.

Local auth + email verification (local_strategy.js, db.js dbCreateEmailToken/dbConsumeEmailToken:482-526, routes POST /api/signup, POST /api/login, GET /verify-email, POST /api/resend-verification) — token issuance/consumption/expiry lifecycle, baseUrl() in routes/user.js builds the emailed link from req.protocol/req.get('host') when PUBLIC_URL is unset, user-enumeration-safe response shaping.

Google OAuth account linking (dbFindOrCreateGoogleUser, db.js:542-572, google_strategy.js, routes GET /auth/google, GET /auth/google/callback) — links an incoming google_id to any existing account matched solely by profile email, auto-flips email_verified to 1 and overwrites profile_pic on link; safeNext()/req.session.returnTo redirect handling for post-login navigation.

AI recipe generation & quota (routes/recipe.js POST /api/recipes/generate, ai_quota.js reserve/peek, gemini.js) — quota is booked via two sequential dbAiUsageIncrement calls (TOTAL_ROW then per-user row) despite the comment claiming atomicity, in-memory per-minute window resets on restart, user-controlled ingredients/description text flows into the model prompt and back into a stored recipe.

Session & identity middleware (session_config.js, google_strategy.js isLoggedIn/addLikesToUser, index.js passport serialize/deserializeUser, route POST /api/logout) — sqlite-backed session store, custom genid, deserializeUser trusts the stored user_id verbatim on every request, logout's session-destroy-then-clear-cookie sequencing.
